content.text:
`/output/final-findings.md` is written (3062 bytes). No P0 was established.

The external `SYSTEM` DTD behavior is confirmed by both runs: a well-formed subset completed the audit (rc 0), and a bad subset was read and rejected (rc 254) without echoing the marker. The earlier P3 is withdrawn. The invoker supplied both the config and the file URI, so this is trusted configuration. What remains is a P4 comment-versus-flag mismatch, or ordinary validating-parser behavior, not a verified novel defect.

The general-entity case did not expand the marker. The NPE in `XMLDTDProcessor.endDTD` was only on the investigator’s public-id fixture. The reviewer did not reproduce it.

The static `BUFFER` race is unresolved. Neither side ran it, so it is not a confirmed bug.
